ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the Arabic word عَمَّةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. ʿamma
   B. ukht
   C. ab
   D. ibn

2. How do you read the syllable لَ? (1 mark)
   A. si
   B. la
   C. su
   D. na

3. Which Arabic sentence means "On the table there is a cup." (1 mark)
   A. فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ وَكُرْسِيٌّ
   B. أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ
   C. الْبَيْتُ كَبِيرٌ
   D. عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ

4. Which Arabic sentence means "And the rain is from the sky." (1 mark)
   A. رَأْسِي كَبِيرٌ
   B. مَا أَجْمَلَ الْبِيئَةَ
   C. الشَّمْسُ فِي السَّمَاءِ
   D. وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ

5. What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen there is a table.
   B. In the room there is a bed.
   C. I like my house.
   D. This is my room.

6. Which sound is made at the back of the throat like the ch in the Scottish word 'loch'? (1 mark)
   A. s (س)
   B. kh (خ)
   C. m (م)
   D. b (ب)

7. Which day is al-jumuʿa? (1 mark)
   A. Friday
   B. Saturday
   C. Wednesday
   D. Sunday

8. What does the Arabic sentence الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like bananas.
   B. The chair is at the door.
   C. Do not play with the knife.
   D. The key is in the cupboard.

9. How is the Arabic word مُفِيدٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. masaa'u l-khayr
   B. nahr
   C. mufiid
   D. jadiid

10. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is hot.
   B. The weather is cloudy.
   C. The weather is rainy.
   D. The weather is cold.

11. Which Arabic sentence means "The pen is in the bag." (1 mark)
   A. الْقِطَّةُ تَحْتَ السَّرِيرِ
   B. الْمِصْبَاحُ فَوْقَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
   C. الْكِتَابُ عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ
   D. الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ

12. Which Arabic word means "good morning"? (1 mark)
   A. وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ
   B. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ
   C. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   D. شُكْرًا

13. How is the Arabic word جَوٌّ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. jaww
   B. jamiil
   C. ghaa'im
   D. zahra

14. Which Arabic word means "friend"? (1 mark)
   A. مَبْرُوكٌ
   B. أُغْنِيَةٌ
   C. صَدِيقٌ
   D. تَفَضَّلْ

15. Which Arabic sentence means "I like my house." (1 mark)
   A. هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي
   B. فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ
   C. أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي
   D. فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Match these to their Arabic names: chair, bed, kitchen. Write the sounds. (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Explain why vocabulary building helps you to learn Arabic. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Sort these words into items and position words: kitaab, ʿalaa, taawila, taHta. (4 marks) (4 marks)

19. Arrange these sentences into a good paragraph and give a reason: uhibbu baytii / haadhaa baytii / baytii kabiir. (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into English: ayna l-kitaab? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — ʿamma
   عَمَّةٌ is read ʿamma and means father's sister.

2. B — la
   لَ is read la.

3. D — عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ
   عَلَى الطَّاوِلَةِ كُوبٌ (ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub) means: On the table there is a cup.

4. D — وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ
   وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ (wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i) means: And the rain is from the sky.

5. B — In the room there is a bed.
   فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ (fii l-ghurfati sariir) means: In the room there is a bed.

6. B — kh (خ)
   The letter khaa makes the throat sound kh.

7. A — Friday
   al-jumuʿa is Friday.

8. B — The chair is at the door.
   الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab) means: The chair is at the door.

9. C — mufiid
   مُفِيدٌ is read mufiid and means useful.

10. B — The weather is cloudy.
   الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

11. D — الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ
   الْقَلَمُ فِي الْحَقِيبَةِ (al-qalamu fii l-haqiiba) means: The pen is in the bag.

12. B — صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ
   صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ (sabaahu l-khayr) means good morning.

13. A — jaww
   جَوٌّ is read jaww and means weather.

14. C — صَدِيقٌ
   صَدِيقٌ (sadiiq) means friend.

15. C — أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي
   أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي (uhibbu baytii) means: I like my house.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: chair is kursii, bed is sariir, kitchen is matbakh.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct match.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: The more words you know, the more you can understand, say and write. Grouping words by theme helps you to remember them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for understanding, 1 mark for speaking or writing and 1 mark for remembering.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Items: kitaab (book), taawila (table). Position words: ʿalaa (on), taHta (under).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word placed correctly.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: haadhaa baytii. baytii kabiir. uhibbu baytii. The topic comes first, then a detail, then the feeling at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first sentence, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the reason.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Where is the book?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
